draft.subject: Heavy Weather Forecast - MV MARRAM STAR
draft.body:
Dear Master,

The office has seen the forecast showing heavy weather from 24 Jan 1800 to 27 Jan 0600, with wind up to Beaufort 8 and seas up to 6.7 m.

Please note that the weather routing service's advice and your own judgement come first; the office supports your decision. Please advise if the ETA changes.

Wishing you and your crew a safe voyage.

Best regards,
Operations
